name: Westfield Century City
demographics: Westfield Century City attracts an affluent, cosmopolitan demographic with household incomes significantly above the Los Angeles median, drawing primarily from the Westside communities of Beverly Hills, Brentwood, Santa Monica, and West Hollywood. The typical visitor profile includes high-earning professionals aged 30-55, entertainment industry executives, and international tourists seeking luxury shopping experiences. The trade area's residents are well-educated urban sophisticates with strong preferences for premium brands, experiential dining, and lifestyle amenities, making this one of the highest-income retail trade areas in the United States.
description: Westfield Century City stands as one of Los Angeles' premier luxury shopping destinations, situated in the heart of the city's prestigious Westside. This iconic mall underwent a stunning $1 billion redevelopment completed in 2017, transforming it into an open-air architectural masterpiece that blends Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle with world-class retail. The center features an exceptional collection of over 200 stores and restaurants, including flagship locations of luxury brands like Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Tiffany & Co., and the innovative Eataly food marketplace. The sophisticated design incorporates lush landscaping, outdoor dining terraces, and contemporary gathering spaces that create an elevated shopping experience. With its Gelson's Market, state-of-the-art Equinox fitness club, premiere dining options, and proximity to Beverly Hills and entertainment industry headquarters, Westfield Century City has established itself as a cultural and retail landmark that attracts discerning shoppers from across the Los Angeles basin.
summary: Westfield Century City is a luxury open-air shopping center in Los Angeles featuring over 200 upscale stores and restaurants, including flagship locations of premier brands like Gucci, Louis Vuitton, and Tiffany & Co. Following a $1 billion redevelopment completed in 2017, it has become one of Southern California's most sophisticated retail destinations.
